entities.summary: Morgan Joe Luttrell is an American politician, businessman, and military veteran serving as the U.S. representative for Texas's 8th congressional district since 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party. On September 11, 2025, Luttrell announced he would not seek re-election in 2026.
